title: Obstructive kidney distal transport programs: donor-level reanalysis code and data
description: Code, verified donor aggregates, expected result tables and figure scripts for a 12-donor secondary analysis of GSE254185. Tumour type and obstruction status are completely confounded; the results describe transcript scores and do not establish physiological transport or an isolated obstruction effect.
